audience: marketers and developers who clean email lists with Emailable

useCases.title: Check your verification credits before a big list
useCases.text: The AI reads the available credits and the account owner's email. You can see if you have enough credits for a list.

useCases.title: Verify one email address
useCases.text: The AI verifies one address and returns the state (deliverable, undeliverable, risky or unknown), the reason, a score from 0 to 100 and flags such as disposable or role. It uses 1 credit.

useCases.title: Verify a list of up to 5000 emails in one batch
useCases.text: The AI starts a batch verification for a list of email addresses. The batch uses 1 credit per address when it is created.

useCases.title: Read the results of a batch
useCases.text: The AI reads a batch's progress and its counts of deliverable, undeliverable, risky and unknown emails. For batches of up to 1,000 emails it also gets the results.
